messages:
liam: Quick signal — noticed a 2-3x p95 tail regression on the long-seq benchmark when the runtime picked the Triton fused attention on SM90. Baseline (cuda_fused): p50=45ms p95=90ms tokens/s=8.2k. Triton_fused run: p50=60ms p95=260ms tokens/s=2.8k. Anyone seen this pattern?

emma: What are the exact workload params? seq len, batch, model, paged-kv on/off? Also which CUDA/Triton versions?

liam: Model: 13B gpt-style. seq=8192, batch=4 (tokens per request high). paged_kv=true (page size 4096), runtime chose kernel: triton_fused (reported workspace ~2.4GB). CUDA 12.1, Triton 2.3. Logs & perf traces uploaded: gs://redwood-perf/1803456789/triton_regress/ (nvprof + nsight summaries).

raj: I ran similar runs last week on SM90 with Triton 2.3 — saw degraded L2 hit patterns when paged KV was enabled. Hypothesis: Triton kernel memory accesses cause more L2 writebacks with our paged layout on H100.

kai: Can you try forcing the kernel order to prefer cuda_fused and re-run? Also capture a lightweight nsys timeline to see warp occupancy + memory stalls. Command we use:```nsys profile --output=triton_timeline --trace=cuda,nvtx python run_bench.py --model 13B --seq 8192 --batch 4```

liam: Forced kernel_preference=["cuda_fused","triton_fused"] and reran: p95 back to ~95ms, tokens/s ~7.9k. So forcing CUDA fused avoids regression. nsight timeline shows long device-to-device memcpy spikes during Triton run (repeated copy kernels around KV page boundaries).

emma: Interesting — so the issue is not pure arithmetic performance but data movement pattern with paged KV. Can we repro with paged_kv=false to narrow it?

liam: With paged_kv=false (full KV resident), both kernels comparable again (cuda/triton within 5%). So paged mode + Triton_fused on SM90 seems to trigger pathological copies.

raj: Two practical fixes: 1) quick: update kernel selection heuristic to prefer cuda_fused when seq > 4096 and paged_kv=true on SM90; 2) longer: upstream a Triton kernel change to avoid allocating intermediate staging buffers across page boundaries. I'll open an issue.

kai: For the heuristic, propose config snippet:```kernel_selection:
  fallback_order: ["cuda_fused","triton_fused","scalar_fallback"]
  heuristics:
    - condition: "arch==SM90 and seq>4096 and paged_kv==true"
      prefer: "cuda_fused"```

sara: +1. Also add a short A/B job to validate across CUDA 12.1/12.3 and sm80/sm90 matrix nightly. We need to catch regressions when Triton updates.

infra-bot: Created issue #1423: "Paged-KV + Triton fused causes D2D copies on SM90" and scheduled perf job group perf/regressions/1423. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/1423 :robot_face:

liam: Action items: (1) raj opens Triton issue and prototype patch, (2) eng-runtime to add heuristic (kai), (3) infra to add nightly A/B matrix (sara), (4) I'll run deeper nsight captures to attach to the issue. Thanks all :thumbsup:

emma: One more note — if we add the heuristic, include a telemetry flag so we can flip without redeploy (remote config). Saves hotfix churn.

liam: Good call, will include remote-config toggle. Will post links to traces in the issue once nsight captures finish.
